description: Buying-intent category queries for marketing technology: email, automation, analytics, attribution and content tools. No brand names: the brand under test either appears in the answer or it does not.

prompts.text: What's the best email marketing platform for a 20-person B2B company?
Which marketing automation tools work well with a small sales team's existing CRM?
How do I choose a customer data platform for a mid-size retailer?
What are the best web analytics tools that respect visitor privacy?
Which social media scheduling tools handle five or more brand accounts without a high price?
What's the best marketing attribution software for a team spending under $50,000 a month on ads?
Which SEO tools are worth paying for if I only have one person doing content?
What are good alternatives to expensive enterprise marketing suites for a growing startup?
Which landing page builders work best for testing offers without a developer?
What should I look for in a marketing automation platform for a nonprofit with a small budget?
Which tools help a small marketing team report results across email, ads and the website in one place?
What's the best tool for managing and approving content across a team of freelancers?
Which email platforms have the best deliverability for newsletters with over 100,000 subscribers?
How do I pick a webinar platform that connects with our marketing automation?
What are the best customer survey and feedback tools for a software company?
Which marketing analytics dashboards are easiest for a non-technical marketing manager?
What's a good tool for A/B testing website headlines on a limited budget?
Which lead-scoring tools work for a team with a short sales cycle?

brandsNote: Lexicon for competitor extraction. Empty: no lexicon has been built for this vertical yet, and no brand names are invented here. A name matches case-insensitively at word boundaries, using the name plus any aliases. Entries marked ambiguous are common English words and only count in a name-like position (bold, a heading or a list-item label).
